deviation.registered_text: Retain only when it is valid JSON containing exactly the supplied C-label permutation; otherwise retain only response hash and validation status.
deviation.executed_behavior: The JSON-mode executor retained the raw response only when it parsed as exactly one integer score in [0,100] per candidate. The accepted response was a root score array or an object containing only a scores array; no C-label permutation was requested or returned.
deviation.classification: preregistration wording does not match this follow-up's score-vector response contract
deviation.result_impact: No metric calculation changed. Retained raw answers consist only of numeric score vectors, with no query, title, excerpt, candidate identifier, or source identifier. Invalid responses were not retained.
deviation.handling: Preserve the original preregistration and result unchanged. Record this deviation explicitly; independent review must assess whether the numeric-only retention is acceptable and whether the experiment can be considered protocol-compliant.

diagnostic_gap.finding: The 12 invalid JSON root arrays were recorded with response shape, response length, token counts, and status, but not safe structural details such as score-vector length or element-type/range counts.
diagnostic_gap.impact: The exact cause of invalidity cannot be reconstructed from the retained artifact. The observed valid-response rate remains auditable; no metric defect was found by review.
diagnostic_gap.handling: Do not rerun or infer missing diagnostics from the discarded responses. Future pilots should preregister and retain only aggregate structural failure counts.

post_run_review_correction.finding: The executor contained an obsolete comment describing the previous C-label permutation contract.
post_run_review_correction.handling: Corrected the comment after inference without changing executable behavior. The registered executor hash above remains the exact code hash used for this run.

historical_transport_evidence_gap.finding: The preregistration and result bind all Ollama endpoint URLs to 127.0.0.1:11434, but the executor used urllib.request.urlopen without recording the proxy environment or forcing a proxy-free opener.
historical_transport_evidence_gap.current_environment_observation: A later check in the same default tool shell found no upper- or lower-case HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, or NO_PROXY variables and urllib.request.getproxies() was empty.
historical_transport_evidence_gap.retrospective_limit: The inference process did not snapshot its environment or opener configuration. The later observation is corroborative only and cannot prove the historical transport path; the result must not claim stronger egress evidence than the record contains.
historical_transport_evidence_gap.post_run_hardening: The successor branch now routes all four reranking pilot executors and their shared offline_embedding_screen embedding calls through one explicit empty ProxyHandler, with strict URL validation for http://127.0.0.1:11434 and the registered Ollama API paths. This only hardens future execution; it does not alter or retrospectively validate this or the other three recorded runs. See data/nomic_rerank_transport_deviation_2026-11-10.json. Any rerun requires a new preregistration and result.
